newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop says all 291 Kowloon flats sold.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop says all 291 Kowloon flats sold.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Monday all 291 units up for sale at its King's Park Villa luxury residential development in Kowloon had been snapped up in the first day of sales on Saturday.

Sun Hung Kai said there were 51 unsold flats remaining in the 342-unit development at Ho Man Tin. Some of the units were for internal subscription, a company spokesman said, adding that no further sales details were immediately available.
Sun Hung Kai said the average price was HK$9,504 per square foot, up from an initial price of HK$8,640 when only 36 units were on offer.
The developer said it intended to put 36 units up for sale but decided to offer 291 due to a strong response.
Prices in the six 21-storey blocks ranged from HK$8 million to about HK$25 million, local newspapers said on Sunday.
